players.bio: Adam Lewis Jackson is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Bromley. Jackson began his career with Middlesbrough and joined Coventry City on loan in September 2015. On 30 August 2016, Jackson signed a 3-year contract for Championship side Barnsley.
Adam Michael Reach is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger or full-back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.

Andrei Coubiș is a 22-year-old professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City and the Romania national team. Standing at an imposing 6ft 5in, he is highly regarded for his physical dominance, composure on the ball, and leadership qualities.
Benjamin House (born 5 July 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for Lincoln City. Born in England, he represented Scotland at youth international level.
Callum Roddie Elder (born 27 January 1995) is an Australian professional football player who plays as a left back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City
Charlie Parks is a 19-year-old professional football player who currently plays as a central defender (wearing squad number 39) for Lincoln City Football Club

Ogbene began his career in Ireland with Cork City and Limerick, before transferring to Brentford in 2018. After a loan spell with Exeter City he moved to Rotherham United in 2019, and then to Luton Town in 2023. After one season with Luton, he signed for Ipswich Town. In 2021, he became the first ever African-born player to represent the Republic of Ireland at senior level.

Christopher David Cohen (born 5 March 1987) is an English former professional footballer and co-head coach at EFL Championship club Lincoln City with Tom Shaw. Primarily a midfielder, he was able to operate equally in the centre or on the left, but was also employed at times as a left-back.
Conor McGrandles (born 24 September 1995) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.
Ayodeji Joshua Oluwapelumi Akinola Elerewe (born 14 September 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.

Dominic William Jefferies (born 22 May 2002) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Jefferies is a product of the Cardiff City and Newport County academies and began his professional career with Brentford B.

Ethan Joseph Wheatley (born 20 January 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Lincoln City on loan from Premier League club Manchester United. He is an England youth international.
Frederick Charles Draper (born 28 July 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.
George Alexander Wickens (born 8 November 2001) is an English footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Lincoln City. He is an England youth international.

Isaac Tanitoluwaloba Aduraoluwatimileyin Olaofe (born 21 November 1999), also known as "Tanto", is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Career Olaofe began his career with Millwall. He moved on loan to Sutton United in February 2020.
Ivan Varfolomeyev is a Ukrainian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.

Jamie Pardington (born 20 July 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. He came through the youth team at Wolverhampton Wanderers, spending time on loan at Bath City, Stratford Town, Dulwich Hamlet and Mansfield Town. During the 2022–23 season he spent time with Grimsby Town and Larne.

Joe Anthony Gauci is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Lincoln City, on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa. He also represents the Australia national team. Born in Australia, Gauci is of Maltese descent and lived on New Zealand's Waiheke Island between the ages of four and eleven, playing club football for Waiheke United.
oshua Honohan is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.

Mason Melia is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Lincoln City on loan from Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Republic of Ireland national team.
Reeco Lee Hackett-Fairchild (born 9 January 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Lincoln City.

Robert Nicholas Street (born 26 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Street began his career with Crystal Palace, and spent time on loan at Torquay United, Newport County and Shrewsbury Town, before signing for Cheltenham Town. A year later he joined Lincoln City.
Ryley Ben Towler (born 6 May 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.

Sonny Bradley (born 13 September 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. He has formerly played for Hull City, Harrogate Town, IK Frej, Aldershot Town, Portsmouth, Crawley Town and Plymouth Argyle, Luton Town.

Tendayi David Darikwa (born 13 December 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Born to expats Zimbabwean parents in Nottingham, he was raised in West Bridgford, Nottinghamshire.

Thomas David Bayliss (born 6 April 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Club Career Bayliss made his professional debut coming on as a substitute on 7 November 2017 in a 2–1 EFL Trophy win over West Brom U23's, coming on to replace Dion Kelly-Evans.

Thomas Philip Hamer (born 01 October 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right back or centre back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Hamer plays mostly as a right back but can also play as a centre back; his former manager Richie Wellens also said he can play defensive midfield.

Thomas William Shaw (born 1 December 1986) is an English former footballer and co-head coach at EFL Championship side Lincoln City with Chris Cohen. Shaw began his career at Rushden & Diamonds, making over 50 appearances in the Football League and Conference between 2006 and 2008.
Yunus Emre Konak (born 10 January 2006) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City on loan from Premier League club Brentford.
